ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: طسٓمٓ ۝١
ayahs.translation: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.[1043]
ayahs.translationClear: Ta, Seen, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.translationClear: These are the Verses of the Clarifying Book.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوْنُوْا مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief, because they do not become believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ نَّشَاْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتْ اَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خٰضِعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.[1044]
ayahs.transliteration: In nasha' nunazzil 'alayhim minas-samaa'i aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

footnotes.1044: i.e., they would be compelled to believe.

ayahs.translationClear: If We will, We can send down upon them a sign from heaven, at which their necks will stay bent in humility.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا يَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa ya'teehim min dhikrim minar-rahmaani muhdathin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen
ayahs.translationClear: No fresh reminder comes to them from the Most Merciful, but they turn their backs at it.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا فَسَيَاْتِيْهِمْ اَنۢ͏ْبٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا مَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: Faqad kadhdhaboo fasaya'teehim ambaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.translationClear: They have denied the truth, but soon will come to them the news of what they ridiculed.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَي الْاَرْضِ كَمْ اَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilal-ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not seen the earth, and how many beautiful pairs We produced therein?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Most surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذْ نَادٰي رَبُّكَ مُوْسٰٓي اَنِ اي͏ٔ͏ْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord called to Moses, “Go to the tyrannical people.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ‌ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ ۝١١
ayahs.translation: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
ayahs.translationClear: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ اَنْ يُّكَذِّبُوْنِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbi innee akhaafu an yukadhdhiboon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, I fear they will reject me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَضِيْقُ صَدْرِيْ وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِيْ فَاَرْسِلْ اِلٰي هٰرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayadeequ sadree walaa yantaliqu lisaanee fa'arsil ilaa haaroon
ayahs.translationClear: And I become stressed, and my tongue is not fluent, so send Aaron too.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢ͏ْبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنْ يَّقْتُلُوْنِ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
ayahs.translationClear: And they have a charge against me, so I fear they will kill me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ كَلَّا‌ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ‌ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُّسْتَمِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala kallaa fadhhabaa bi'aayaatinaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “No. Go, both of you, with Our proofs. We will be with you, listening.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُوْلَا͏ٓ اِنَّا رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers[1045] of the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'tiyaa fir'awna faqoolaa innaa rasoolu rabbil-'aalameen

footnotes.1045: The singular form in Arabic indicates that both were sent with a single message.

ayahs.translationClear: Go to Pharaoh, and say, ‘We are the messengers of the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
ayahs.translationClear: Let the Children of Israel go with us.’”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِيْنَا وَلِيْدًا وَّلَبِثْتَ فِيْنَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedan walabithta feenaa min 'umurika sineen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed among us for many of your years?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِيْ فَعَلْتَ وَاَنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [then] you did your deed which you did,[1046] and you were of the ungrateful."

footnotes.1046: i.e., striking the Copt, who died as a result.

ayahs.translationClear: And you committed that deed you committed, and you were ungrateful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا͏ٓ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّا࢜لِّيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I did it then, when I was of those astray.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِيْ رَبِّيْ حُكْمًا وَّجَعَلَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophethood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
ayahs.transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lammaa khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman waja'alanee minal-mursaleen
ayahs.translationClear: And I fled from you when I feared you; but my Lord gave me wisdom, and made me one of the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ اَنْ عَبَّدْتَّ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
ayahs.transliteration: Watilka ni'matun tamunnuhaa 'alayya an 'abbadtta banee israa'eel
ayahs.translationClear: Is that the favor you taunt me with, although you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.translationClear: Pharaoh said, “And what is the Lord of the Worlds?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ‌ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاؕ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, if you are aware.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
ayahs.translationClear: He said to those around him, “Do you not hear?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of old.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوْلَكُمُ الَّذِيْٓ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said,[1047] "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala inna rasoolakumul-ladhee ursila ilaykum lamajnoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “This messenger of yours, who is sent to you, is crazy.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ‌ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاؕ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbul-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamaa baynahumaa in kuntum ta'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Lord of the East and the West, and everything between them, if you understand.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَىِٕنِ اتَّخَذْتَ اِلٰهًا غَيْرِيْ لَاَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُوْنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala la'inittakhadhta ilaahan ghayree la'aj'alannaka minal-masjooneen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “If you accept any god other than me, I will make you a prisoner.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “What if I bring you something convincing?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَاْتِ بِهٖٓ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala fa'ti bihee in kunta minas-saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Bring it, if you are being truthful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَلْقٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.[1048]
ayahs.translationClear: So he cast his staff; and it was a serpent, plain to see.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَا࢜ءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wanaza'a yadahoo fa'idhaa hiya baydaa'u linnaazireen
ayahs.translationClear: And he pulled his hand; and it was white, for all to see.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لِلْمَلَاِ حَوْلَهٗٓ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala lilmala'i hawlahoo inna haadhaa lasaahirun 'aleem
ayahs.translationClear: He said to the dignitaries around him, “This is a skilled magician.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: يُّرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهٖࣗۖ فَمَاذَا تَاْمُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
ayahs.transliteration: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaadhaa ta'muroon
ayahs.translationClear: He intends to drive you out of your land with his magic, so what do you recommend?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا اَرْجِهْ وَاَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَا࢜ىِٕنِ حٰشِرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo arjih wa'akhaahu wab'ath fil-madaa'ini haashireen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Delay him and his brother, and send recruiters to the cities.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ ۝٣٧
ayahs.translation: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
ayahs.translationClear: To bring you every experienced magician.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.[1049]

footnotes.1049: i.e., the morning of the day of festival. See 20:58-59.

ayahs.translationClear: So the magicians were gathered for the appointment on a specified day.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
ayahs.translationClear: And it was said to the people, “Are you all gathered?

ayahs.textUthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
ayahs.translationClear: That we may follow the magicians, if they are the winners.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ اَىِٕنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaaloo lifir'awna a'inna lanaa la'ajran in kunnaa nahnul-ghaalibeen
ayahs.translationClear: When the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there a reward for us, if we are the winners?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ

words.translation: the ones who are brought near

ayahs.translation: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Yes, and you will be among those favored.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰٓي اَلْقُوْا مَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ مُّلْقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala lahum moosaa alqoo maa antum mulqoon
ayahs.translationClear: Moses said to them, “Present what you intend to present.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'alqaw hibaalahum wa'isiyyahum waqaaloo bi'izzati fir'awna innaa lanahnul-ghaaliboon
ayahs.translationClear: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the winners.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَلْقٰي مُوْسٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَاْفِكُوْنَ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'alqaa moosaa 'asaahu fa'idhaa hiya talqafu maa ya'fikoon
ayahs.translationClear: Then Moses threw his staff, and behold, it began swallowing their trickery.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
ayahs.translationClear: And the magicians fell down prostrating.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.translation: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.translation: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.translationClear: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ‌ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيْرُكُمُ الَّذِيْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَۚ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ࣢ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۚ

words.translation: and I will surely crucify you

ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aadhana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul-ladhee 'allamakumus-sihra falasawfa ta'lamoona la'uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa'arjulakum min khilaafin wala'usallibannakum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Did you believe in Him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon know. I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ‌ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَؗ اِنَّا͏ٓ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo laa dayra innaa ilaa rabbinaa munqaliboon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “No problem. To our Lord we will return.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا نَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰنَا͏ٓ اَنْ كُنَّا͏ٓ اَوَّلَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ؕࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa natma'u an yaghfira lanaa rabbunaa khataayaanaa an kunnaa awwalal-mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: We are eager for our Lord to forgive us our sins, since we are the first of the believers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي مُوْسٰٓي اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْٓ اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an asri bi'ibaadee innakum muttaba'oon
ayahs.translationClear: And We inspired Moses: “Travel with My servants by night. You will be followed.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.translation: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers[1050]

footnotes.1050: Recruiters of an army to prevent the emigration of the Children of Israel.

ayahs.translationClear: Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.translation: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
ayahs.translationClear: “These are a small gang.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they are enraging us,
ayahs.translationClear: And they are enraging us.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.translation: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
ayahs.translationClear: But we are a vigilant multitude.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝٥٧
ayahs.translation: So We removed them from gardens and springs
ayahs.translationClear: So We drove them out of gardens and springs.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ ۝٥٨
ayahs.translation: And treasures and honorable station[1051] -

footnotes.1051: Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) caused them to abandon their wealth and property in pursuit of the Israelites.

ayahs.translationClear: And treasures and noble dwellings.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ۝٥٩

words.translation: And We caused to inherit them

ayahs.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
ayahs.translationClear: So it was. And We made the Children of Israel inherit them.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ ۝٦٠
ayahs.translation: So they pursued them at sunrise.
ayahs.translationClear: And they pursued them at sunrise.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا تَرَا࢜ءَ الْجَمْعٰنِ قَالَ اَصْحٰبُ مُوْسٰٓي اِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa taraa'al-jam'aani qaala as'haabu moosaa innaa lamudrakoon
ayahs.translationClear: When the two groups sighted each other, the followers of Moses said, “We are being overtaken.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ كَلَّآ‌ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ اِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّيْ سَيَهْدِيْنِ
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala kallaa inna ma'iya rabbee sayahdeen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “No; my Lord is with me, He will guide me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ‌ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي مُوْسٰٓي اَنِ اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَؕ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa anidrib bi'asaakal-bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kat-tawdil-'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff.” Whereupon it parted, and each part was like a huge hill.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.translation: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
ayahs.translationClear: And there We brought the others near.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.translation: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
ayahs.translationClear: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.translation: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.translationClear: Then We drowned the others.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: In that there is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٦٨
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.translation: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
ayahs.translationClear: And relate to them the story of Abraham.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala li'abeehi waqawmihee maa ta'budoon
ayahs.translationClear: When he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ اَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We worship idols, and we remain devoted to them.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.translation: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Do they hear you when you pray?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.translation: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they benefit you, or harm you?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا͏ٓ اٰبَا࢜ءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo bal wajadnaa aabaa'anaa kadhaalika yaf'aloon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “But we found our ancestors doing so.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.translation: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Have you considered what you worship?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ ۝٧٦
ayahs.translation: You and your ancient forefathers?
ayahs.translationClear: You and your ancient ancestors?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّيْٓ اِلَّا رَبَّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,[1052]

footnotes.1052: The people worshipped idols in addition to Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: They are enemies to me, but not so the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ ۝٧٨
ayahs.translation: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
ayahs.translationClear: He who created me, and guides me.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ ۝٧٩
ayahs.translation: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
ayahs.translationClear: He who feeds me, and waters me.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ ۝٨٠
ayahs.translation: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
ayahs.translationClear: And when I get sick, He heals me.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ ۝٨١
ayahs.translation: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
ayahs.translationClear: He who makes me die, and then revives me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْٓ اَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لِيْ خَطِيْ࢜ـٔ͏َتِيْ يَوْمَ الدِّيْنِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladhee atma'u an yaghfira lee khatee'atee yawmad-deen
ayahs.translationClear: He who, I hope, will forgive my sins on the Day of the Reckoning.”

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ حُكْمًا وَّاَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصّٰلِحِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman wa'alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
ayahs.translationClear: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاجْعَلْ لِّيْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْاٰخِرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
ayahs.translationClear: And give me a reputation of truth among the others.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٨٥
ayahs.translation: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
ayahs.translationClear: And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاغْفِرْ لِاَبِيْٓ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّا࢜لِّيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
ayahs.translationClear: And forgive my father—he was one of the misguided.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.translation: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
ayahs.translationClear: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalun walaa banoon
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when neither wealth nor children will help.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَي اللّٰهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيْمٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
ayahs.translationClear: Except for him who comes to Allah with a sound heart.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٩٠
ayahs.translation: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
ayahs.translationClear: And Paradise will be brought near for the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ ۝٩١
ayahs.translation: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
ayahs.translationClear: And the Blaze will be displayed to the deviators.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ ۝٩٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقِيْلَ لَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
ayahs.transliteration: Waqeela lahum ayna maa kuntum ta'budoon
ayahs.translationClear: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship?

ayahs.textUthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ ۝٩٣
ayahs.textIndopak: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِؕ هَلْ يَنْصُرُوْنَكُمْ اَوْ يَنْتَصِرُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
ayahs.transliteration: Min doonillaahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Besides Allah? Can they help you, or help themselves?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ ۝٩٤
ayahs.translation: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
ayahs.translationClear: Then they will be toppled into it, together with the seducers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ ۝٩٥
ayahs.translation: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
ayahs.translationClear: And the soldiers of Satan, all of them.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ ۝٩٦
ayahs.translation: They will say while they dispute therein,
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, as they feud in it.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: تَاللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنَّا لَفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
ayahs.transliteration: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: “By Allah, we were in evident error.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٩٨
ayahs.translation: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.translationClear: For equating you with the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ۝٩٩
ayahs.translation: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
ayahs.translationClear: No one misled us except the sinners.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ ۝١٠٠
ayahs.translation: So now we have no intercessors
ayahs.translationClear: Now we have no intercessors.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ ۝١٠١
ayahs.translation: And not a devoted friend.
ayahs.translationClear: And no sincere friend.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٠٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَوْ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."[1053]
ayahs.transliteration: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal-mu'mineen

footnotes.1053: The conclusion of this verse is estimated as "...we would do this or that."

ayahs.translationClear: If only we could have another chance, we would be among the faithful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٠٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝١٠٤
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝١٠٥
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah denied the messengers[1054]
ayahs.translationClear: The people of Noah disbelieved the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٠٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ نُوْحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala lahum akhoohum noohun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: Their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ ۝١٠٧
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.translationClear: I am to you a faithful messenger.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٠٨
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ‌ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٠٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١١٠
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me."
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ ۝١١١
ayahs.translation: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Shall we believe in you, when it is the lowliest who follow you?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝١١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِيْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “What do I know about what they do?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى‌ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ ۝١١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّيْ لَوْ تَشْعُرُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
ayahs.transliteration: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa rabbee law tash'uroon
ayahs.translationClear: Their account rests only with my Lord, if you have sense.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١١٤
ayahs.translation: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
ayahs.translationClear: And I am not about to drive away the believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝١١٥
ayahs.translation: I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.translationClear: I am only a clear warner.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ ۝١١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰنُوْحُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُوْمِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaanoohu latakoonanna minal-marjoomeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “If you do not refrain, O Noah, you will be stoned.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ ۝١١٧
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, my people have denied me.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَّنَجِّنِيْ وَمَنْ مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
ayahs.transliteration: Faftah baynee wabaynahum fat'han wanajjinee wamam ma'iya minal-mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: So judge between me and them decisively, and deliver me and the believers who are with me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ ۝١١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعَهٗ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
ayahs.translationClear: So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ ۝١٢٠
ayahs.translation: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
ayahs.translationClear: Then We drowned the rest.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: In that is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝١٢٢
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝١٢٣
ayahs.translation: ʿAad denied the messengers
ayahs.translationClear: Aad disbelieved the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ هُوْدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala lahum akhoohum hoodun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: When their brother Hud said to them, “Do you not fear?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ ۝١٢٥
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.translationClear: I am to you a faithful messenger.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٢٦
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ‌ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ ۝١٢٨
ayahs.translation: Do you construct on every elevation a sign,[1055] amusing yourselves,

footnotes.1055: i.e., a symbol or indication of their wealth and power. They used to build lofty structures along the road to be seen by all who passed by.

ayahs.translationClear: Do you build a monument on every height for vanity’s sake?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ ۝١٢٩
ayahs.translation: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
ayahs.translationClear: And you set up fortresses, hoping to live forever?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ ۝١٣٠
ayahs.translation: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
ayahs.translationClear: And when you strike, you strike mercilessly?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٣١
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝١٣٢
ayahs.translation: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
ayahs.translationClear: And reverence Him, who supplied you with everything you know.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ ۝١٣٣
ayahs.translation: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
ayahs.translationClear: He supplied you with livestock and children.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝١٣٤
ayahs.translation: And gardens and springs.
ayahs.translationClear: And gardens and springs.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ ۝١٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.translationClear: I fear for you the punishment of an awesome Day.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ ۝١٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا سَوَا࢜ءٌ عَلَيْنَا͏ٓ اَوَعَظْتَ اَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْوٰعِظِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo sawaa'un 'alaynaa awa'azta am lam takum minal-waa'izeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “It is the same for us, whether you lecture us, or do not lecture.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٣٧
ayahs.translation: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
ayahs.translationClear: This is nothing but morals of the ancients.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ ۝١٣٨
ayahs.translation: And we are not to be punished."
ayahs.translationClear: And we will not be punished.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَهْلَكْنٰهُمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Fakadhdhaboohu fa'ahlaknaahum inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝١٤٠
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝١٤١
ayahs.translation: Thamūd denied the messengers
ayahs.translationClear: Thamood disbelieved the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala lahum akhoohum saalihun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: When their brother Saleh said to them, “Do you not fear?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ ۝١٤٣
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.translationClear: I am to you a faithful messenger.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٤٤
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ‌ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ ۝١٤٦
ayahs.translation: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
ayahs.translationClear: Will you be left secure in what is here?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝١٤٧
ayahs.translation: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.translationClear: In gardens and springs?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ ۝١٤٨
ayahs.translation: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
ayahs.translationClear: And fields, and palm-trees whose fruits are delicious?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ ۝١٤٩
ayahs.translation: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
ayahs.translationClear: And you skillfully carve houses in the mountains?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٥٠
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ ۝١٥١
ayahs.translation: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
ayahs.translationClear: And do not obey the command of the extravagant.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ ۝١٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ يُفْسِدُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
ayahs.translationClear: Who spread turmoil on earth, and do not reform.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ ۝١٥٣
ayahs.translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “You are surely one of the bewitched.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ ۝١٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَاۚۖ فَاْتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: Maa anta illaa basharum mithlunaa fa'ti bi'aayatin in kunta minas-saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: You are nothing but a man like us. So bring us a sign, if you are truthful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ ۝١٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: He said, "This is a she-camel.[1056] For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala haadhihee naaqatul lahaa shirbun walakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom

footnotes.1056: Miraculously sent to them as a sign by Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: He said, “This is a she-camel; she has her turn of drinking, and you have your turn of drinking—on a specified day.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ ۝١٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْ࢜ءٍ فَيَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.translationClear: And do not touch her with harm, lest the punishment of a great day seizes you.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ ۝١٥٧
ayahs.translation: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
ayahs.translationClear: But they slaughtered her, and became full of remorse.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'akhadhahumul-'adhaabu inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝١٥٩
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝١٦٠
ayahs.translation: The people of Lot denied the messengers
ayahs.translationClear: The people of Lot disbelieved the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ لُوْطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala lahum akhoohum lootun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: When their brother Lot said to them, “Do you not fear?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ ۝١٦٢
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.translationClear: I am to you a faithful messenger.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٦٣
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ‌ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٦٥
ayahs.translation: Do you approach males among the worlds[1057]

footnotes.1057: i.e., Are there, out of all Allāh's creatures, any besides you who commit this unnatural act?

ayahs.translationClear: Do you approach the males of the world?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم‌ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ ۝١٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَذَرُوْنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْؕ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عٰدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
ayahs.transliteration: Watadharoona maa khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwaajikum bal antum qawmun 'aadoon
ayahs.translationClear: And forsake the wives your Lord created for you? Indeed, you are intrusive people.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ ۝١٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰلُوْطُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaalootu latakoonanna minal-mukhrajeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will be expelled.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ ۝١٦٨
ayahs.translation: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I certainly deplore your conduct.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٦٩
ayahs.translation: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
ayahs.translationClear: “My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝١٧٠
ayahs.translation: So We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.translationClear: So We saved him and his family, all together.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ ۝١٧١
ayahs.translation: Except an old woman[1058] among those who remained behind.

footnotes.1058: Lot's wife, who had collaborated with the evildoers.

ayahs.translationClear: Except for an old woman among those who tarried.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ ۝١٧٢
ayahs.translation: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.translationClear: Then We destroyed the others.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا‌ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ ۝١٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَا࢜ءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
ayahs.translationClear: And We rained down on them a rain. Dreadful is the rain of those forewarned.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝١٧٥
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝١٧٦
ayahs.translation: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers
ayahs.translationClear: The people of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala lahum shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: When Shuaib said to them, “Do you not fear?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ ۝١٧٨
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.translationClear: I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝١٧٩
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.translationClear: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ‌ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـٔ͏َلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ ۝١٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
ayahs.translationClear: Give full measure, and do not cheat.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۝١٨٢
ayahs.translation: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
ayahs.translationClear: And weigh with accurate scales.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ ۝١٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَا࢜ءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
ayahs.translationClear: And do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not work corruption in the land.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٨٤
ayahs.translation: And fear He who created you and the former creation."[1059]
ayahs.translationClear: And fear Him who created you and the masses of old.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ ۝١٨٥
ayahs.translation: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “You are one of those bewitched.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ ۝١٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَاِنْ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa anta illaa basharum mithlunaa wa'in nazunnuka laminal-kaadhibeen
ayahs.translationClear: And you are nothing but a man like us; and we think that you are a liar.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ ۝١٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'asqit 'alaynaa kisafam minas-samaa'i in kunta minas-saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: So bring down on us pieces from the sky, if you are truthful.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٨٨
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord is well aware of what you do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ ۝١٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
ayahs.transliteration: Fakadhdhaboohu fa'akhadhahum 'adhaabu yawmiz-zullati innahoo kaana 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: But they denied him. So the punishment of the day of gloom gripped them. It was the punishment of a great day.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً‌ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٩٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatan wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝١٩١
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٩٢
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.translationClear: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ ۝١٩٣
ayahs.translation: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
ayahs.translationClear: The Honest Spirit came down with it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ ۝١٩٤
ayahs.translation: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners
ayahs.translationClear: Upon your heart, that you may be one of the warners.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ ۝١٩٥
ayahs.translation: In a clear Arabic language.
ayahs.translationClear: In a clear Arabic tongue.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٩٦
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
ayahs.translationClear: And it is in the scriptures of the ancients.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ۝١٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ اٰيَةً اَنْ يَّعْلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yakul lahum aayatan an ya'lamahoo 'ulamaa'u banee israa'eel
ayahs.translationClear: Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ ۝١٩٨
ayahs.translation: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners[1060]

footnotes.1060: i.e., the non-Arabs or those who are not fluent in the Arabic language.

ayahs.translationClear: Had We revealed it to one of the foreigners.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٩٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيْهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And he had recited it to them [perfectly],[1061] they would [still] not have been believers in it.
ayahs.translationClear: And he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۝٢٠٠
ayahs.translation: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
ayahs.translationClear: Thus We make it pass through the hearts of the guilty.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ ۝٢٠١
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
ayahs.translationClear: They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ۝٢٠٢

words.translation: And it will come to them

ayahs.translation: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.translationClear: It will come to them suddenly, while they are unaware.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ ۝٢٠٣
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
ayahs.translationClear: Then they will say, “Are we given any respite?”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ ۝٢٠٤

words.translation: So is it for Our punishment

ayahs.translation: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.translationClear: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ ۝٢٠٥
ayahs.translation: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
ayahs.translationClear: Have you considered: if We let them enjoy themselves for some years.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ ۝٢٠٦
ayahs.translation: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
ayahs.translationClear: Then there comes to them what they were promised.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ ۝٢٠٧
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا͏ٓ اَغْنٰي عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يُمَتَّعُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
ayahs.translationClear: Of what avail to them will be their past enjoyments?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ ۝٢٠٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُوْنَ ࣗۖۛ
ayahs.translation: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa mundhiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Never did We destroy a town, but it had warners.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٢٠٩
ayahs.translation: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
ayahs.translationClear: As a reminder—We are never unjust.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ ۝٢١٠
ayahs.translation: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.[1062]

footnotes.1062: As was asserted by the disbelievers. Rather, it was brought by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.

ayahs.translationClear: It was not the devils that revealed it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ۝٢١١
ayahs.translation: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
ayahs.translationClear: It is not in their interests, nor in their power.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ ۝٢١٢
ayahs.translation: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.[1063]
ayahs.translationClear: They are barred from hearing.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ ۝٢١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: So do not invoke[1064] with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa tad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal-mu'adhdhabeen
ayahs.translationClear: So do not pray to another god with Allah, else you will be of those tormented.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ ۝٢١٤
ayahs.translation: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
ayahs.translationClear: And warn your close relatives.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٢١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
ayahs.translationClear: And lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٢١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّيْ بَرِيْ࢜ءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'in 'asawka faqul innee baree'um mimmaa ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: And if they disobey you, say, “I am innocent of what you do.”

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝٢١٧
ayahs.translation: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.translationClear: And put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ ۝٢١٨
ayahs.translation: Who sees you when you arise[1065]

footnotes.1065: From your bed at night for prayer while you are alone.

ayahs.translationClear: He who sees you when you rise.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ ۝٢١٩
ayahs.translation: And your movement among those who prostrate.[1066]

footnotes.1066: i.e., among those who pray with you in congregation.

ayahs.translationClear: And your devotions amidst the worshipers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٢٢٠
ayahs.translation: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.translationClear: He is indeed the Hearer, the Aware.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ ۝٢٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: هَلْ اُنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ عَلٰي مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطِيْنُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
ayahs.translationClear: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ ۝٢٢٢
ayahs.translation: They descend upon every sinful liar.
ayahs.translationClear: They descend upon every sinful liar.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَـٰذِبُونَ ۝٢٢٣
ayahs.translation: They pass on what is heard,[1067] and most of them are liars.

footnotes.1067: This was before they were prevented, as described in 72:8-9.

ayahs.translationClear: They give ear, and most of them are liars.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ ۝٢٢٤
ayahs.translation: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them.
ayahs.translationClear: And as for the poets—the deviators follow them.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ ۝٢٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّهُمْ فِيْ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيْمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that in every valley they roam[1068]
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadin yaheemoon

footnotes.1068: Speaking lies indiscriminately and praising and disparaging others according to whim.

ayahs.translationClear: Do you not see how they ramble in every style?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ ۝٢٢٦
ayahs.translation: And that they say what they do not do? -
ayahs.translationClear: And how they say what they do not do?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟‌ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ ۝٢٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا وَّانْتَصَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْاؕ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَّنْقَلِبُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims][1069] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: Illal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wadhakarullaaha katheeran wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo wasaya'lamul-ladheena zalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboon

footnotes.1069: By replying through poetry to the attacks of hostile poets.

ayahs.translationClear: Except for those who believe, and do good deeds, and remember Allah frequently, and defend themselves after they are wronged. As for those who do wrong, they will know by what overturning they will be overturned.
